answer: Name the clone sable. wharf is the sole admission ledger binding key, endpoint and a parent permit, so twins collide. oasis is the burn minting permits on one global curve: permit k costs k^3 oasis and every mint re-prices all later permits, while permits are soulbound and slash if two sable answer one challenge. n heads therefore need 1^3+...+n^3 oasis in order, not lendable or parallel. It breaks if wharf dedups weakly, permits detach, or oasis transfers.
